text: {"lessons":["A few months of mixed returns are too little evidence to justify reacting to short-term price moves; I should stay patient and review my long-term plan.","Diversification can soften individual-stock risk, but it cannot prevent losses when the overall portfolio falls; I should keep risk appropriate to my goals and time horizon.","Because losses weigh heavily on me, I should avoid panic-selling after a decline and make any changes deliberately, based on fundamentals and portfolio balance."]}
